title: Where a change in estimate goes

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
In FY 2025-26 Kalmira raises its estimate of total cost on a two-year fixed-price contract with {customer}. How is the effect on revenue recognised?

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.

rubric.text: Cumulative catch-up in the current year (para 43).

options: Spread it over the rest of the contract
explanation: The measure of progress is updated, and the change is accounted for as a change in accounting estimate (para 43): revenue to date is caught up in the current year.

mistakes.feedback: A revised cost estimate is a change in accounting estimate, not an error. Last year is not restated (para 43, Ind AS 8).

mistakes.choice: Spread it over the rest of the contract
mistakes.feedback: Revenue to date is recomputed with the new measure of progress at once, so the effect on revenue to date falls in the current year (para 43).
